<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const navContainer = document.querySelector(".friday-nav");
  if (!navContainer) return;

  const section = navContainer.closest(".shopify-section");
  if (section) section.classList.add("header-nav-sticky");

  const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[friday-name]"));
  if (!sections.length) return;

  const navLinks = [];
  let isScrolling = false; // 点击触发滚动时为 true，阻止自动更新覆盖

  function isNavScrollable() {
    return navContainer.scrollWidth > navContainer.clientWidth + 2;
  }

  // 平滑纵向滚动并等待稳定
  function smoothScrollToY(targetY) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const tolerance = 2;
      let stableFrames = 0;
      const maxStableFrames = 4;

      window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, Math.round(targetY)), behavior: "smooth" });

      function check() {
        const cur = window.scrollY;
        if (Math.abs(cur - targetY) <= tolerance) stableFrames++;
        else stableFrames = 0;

        if (stableFrames >= maxStableFrames || Math.abs(cur - targetY) <= tolerance) {
          resolve();
        } else {
          requestAnimationFrame(check);
        }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(check);
    });
  }

  // 横向滚动到元素中心（clamp 到最大值），等稳定后 resolve
  function smoothScrollNavTo(elem) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!isNavScrollable()) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        const navClientWidth = navContainer.clientWidth;
        const elemCenter = elem.offsetLeft + elem.offsetWidth / 2;
        let targetLeft = Math.round(elemCenter - navClientWidth / 2);

        const maxScrollLeft = Math.max(0, navContainer.scrollWidth - navClientWidth);
        targetLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(targetLeft, maxScrollLeft));

        navContainer.scrollTo({ left: targetLeft, behavior: "smooth" });

        const tolerance = 1;
        let stableFrames = 0;
        const maxStableFrames = 4;

        function check() {
          const cur = navContainer.scrollLeft;
          if (Math.abs(cur - targetLeft) <= tolerance) stableFrames++;
          else stableFrames = 0;

          if (stableFrames >= maxStableFrames || Math.abs(cur - targetLeft) <= tolerance) {
            resolve();
          } else {
            requestAnimationFrame(check);
          }
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(check);
      }, 60);
    });
  }

  // 生成导航按钮
  sections.forEach((sec, index) => {
    const name = sec.getAttribute("friday-name");
    const id = sec.id;
    if (!name || !id) return;

    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = `#${id}`;
    a.textContent = name;
    a.classList.add("friday-nav-link");

    a.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isScrolling) return;
      isScrolling = true;

      // 立刻更新 UI active（给用户反馈）
      navLinks.forEach(l => l.classList.remove("active"));
      a.classList.add("active");

      // 纵向目标：模块顶部贴在 nav 下面
      const navH = navContainer.offsetHeight;
      const targetTop = sec.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - navH;

      // 等纵向滚动完成
      await smoothScrollToY(targetTop);

      // 再做横向滚动（只有溢出时）
      if (isNavScrollable()) {
        await smoothScrollNavTo(a);
      }

      // 手动刷新一次 active（确保准确），然后解除锁
      updateActiveOnScroll();
      setTimeout(() => { isScrolling = false; }, 80);
    });

    navContainer.appendChild(a);
    navLinks.push(a);

    if (index === 0) a.classList.add("active");
  });

  // 刷新布局与 justify
  function refreshNavLayout() {
    const gap = 12;
    const totalWidth = navLinks.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.offsetWidth, 0) + Math.max(0, navLinks.length - 1) * gap;
    if (totalWidth > navContainer.clientWidth) {
      navContainer.classList.add("scrollable");
      navContainer.style.justifyContent = "flex-start";
    } else {
      navContainer.classList.remove("scrollable");
      navContainer.style.justifyContent = "center";
    }
  }

  // 使用导航底部（navContainer.getBoundingClientRect().bottom）作为锚点判断激活（与点击滚动对齐）
  function updateActiveOnScroll() {
    const anchorY = navContainer.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
    const lastSec = sections[sections.length - 1];
    const lastTop = lastSec.getBoundingClientRect().top;

    // ⭐ 只要滚动超过最后一个模块的顶部 -> 永远激活最后一个
    if (lastTop <= anchorY + 2) {
      if (!isScrolling) {
        navLinks.forEach(l => l.classList.remove("active"));
        navLinks[navLinks.length - 1]?.classList.add("active");
      }
      if (isNavScrollable()) smoothScrollNavTo(navLinks[navLinks.length - 1]).catch(()=>{});
      return;
    }

    // 🔽 其他模块正常检测
    let found = false;

    sections.forEach((sec, idx) => {
      const rect = sec.getBoundingClientRect();

      if (rect.top <= anchorY + 2 && rect.bottom > anchorY + 2) {
        found = true;

        if (!isScrolling) {
          navLinks.forEach(l => l.classList.remove("active"));
          navLinks[idx]?.classList.add("active");
        }

        if (isNavScrollable()) smoothScrollNavTo(navLinks[idx]).catch(()=>{});
      }
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener("scroll", updateActiveOnScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    refreshNavLayout();
    updateActiveOnScroll();
  });

  // init
  refreshNavLayout();
  updateActiveOnScroll();

  // ✅ 移动端兜底：任何触摸结束，都强制解锁
  window.addEventListener("touchend", () => {
    isScrolling = false;
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener("touchcancel", () => {
    isScrolling = false;
  }, { passive: true });

});
</script>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('#shopify-section-template--18470869041330__video_text_selling_points_abkCAx .sv-banner').forEach(banner => {
  
  const trigger = banner.querySelector('.js-video-trigger');

  if (!trigger) return;

  const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

  const getVideo = () => {
    if (isMobile) {
      return banner.querySelector('.sv-video--mobile video, .sv-video--mobile');
    }
    return banner.querySelector('.sv-video--desktop video, .sv-video--desktop');
  };

  const video = getVideo();

  // ✅ 移动端：自动播放
  if (isMobile && video) {
    banner.classList.add('is-playing');
    video.currentTime = 0;
    video.play();
  }

  // ✅ PC：点击播放
  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    const video = getVideo();
    if (!video) return;

    banner.classList.add('is-playing');
    video.currentTime = 0;
    video.play();

    trigger.classList.add('is-playing');
  });

  // ✅ 监听结束
  banner.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(video => {
    video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
      banner.classList.remove('is-playing');
      trigger.classList.remove('is-playing');
    });
  });

});
</script>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('#shopify-section-template--18470869041330__video_text_selling_points_hcXMzE .sv-banner').forEach(banner => {
  
  const trigger = banner.querySelector('.js-video-trigger');

  if (!trigger) return;

  const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

  const getVideo = () => {
    if (isMobile) {
      return banner.querySelector('.sv-video--mobile video, .sv-video--mobile');
    }
    return banner.querySelector('.sv-video--desktop video, .sv-video--desktop');
  };

  const video = getVideo();

  // ✅ 移动端：自动播放
  if (isMobile && video) {
    banner.classList.add('is-playing');
    video.currentTime = 0;
    video.play();
  }

  // ✅ PC：点击播放
  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    const video = getVideo();
    if (!video) return;

    banner.classList.add('is-playing');
    video.currentTime = 0;
    video.play();

    trigger.classList.add('is-playing');
  });

  // ✅ 监听结束
  banner.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(video => {
    video.addEventListener('ended', () => {
      banner.classList.remove('is-playing');
      trigger.classList.remove('is-playing');
    });
  });

});
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const stack = document.getElementById('stack');
  const slides = Array.from(stack.querySelectorAll('.slide-wrap'));

  let isPointerDown = false;
  let startX = 0, startY = 0;
  let offsetX = 0;
  let activeEl = null;
  let rafId = null;
  let isAnimating = false;
  const THRESHOLD = Math.max(24, window.innerWidth / 12); // 最低阈值保护
  const FLY_DURATION = 240;
  const FLY_DISTANCE = Math.round(window.innerWidth * 0.5);

function applyStackClasses(arr){
  arr.forEach((el,i)=>{
    el.classList.remove('top','middle','bottom','hide');

    if(i===0) el.classList.add('top');
    else if(i===1) el.classList.add('middle');
    else if(i===2) el.classList.add('bottom');
    else el.classList.add('hide');

    el.dataset.index = i+1;
  });
}


  let order = slides.slice();
  applyStackClasses(order);

  // rAF 更新函数：把 transform 的写操作集中在动画帧
  scheduleTransformWrite = () => {
    if (rafId) return;
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (activeEl) {
        // 拖拽横移 + 微 scale
        const dragRatio = Math.min(Math.abs(offsetX) / window.innerWidth, 0.05); // 最大放大 5%
        activeEl.style.transform = `translate3d(${offsetX}px,0,0) scale(${1 + dragRatio})`;
      }
      rafId = null;
    });
  };

  function onPointerDown(e){
    if (isAnimating) return;
    const el = e.currentTarget;
    if (!el.classList.contains('top')) return;
    if (e.target.closest('.video-control-wrapper, .play-button')) return;

    isPointerDown = true;
    activeEl = el;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    offsetX = 0;
    activeEl.classList.add('no-transition');
    activeEl.dataset.dragDirection = '';

    // ⚡ 拖拽时暂停视频
    const videoMediaEl = activeEl.querySelector("video-media-optimized");
    if (videoMediaEl && videoMediaEl.hasAttribute("playing")) {
      const player = videoMediaEl.querySelector("video");
      if (player && !player.paused) {
        player.pause();
      }
    }


    try { activeEl.setPointerCapture && activeEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err){}
  }

  function onPointerMove(e){
    if (!isPointerDown || !activeEl) return;

    const deltaX = e.clientX - startX;
    const deltaY = e.clientY - startY;

    // 确定方向（只在起始阶段判断一次）
    if (!activeEl.dataset.dragDirection) {
      if (Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY) && Math.abs(deltaX) > 5) {
        activeEl.dataset.dragDirection = 'horizontal';
      } else if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > 5) {
        activeEl.dataset.dragDirection = 'vertical';
      } else {
        return;
      }
    }

    if (activeEl.dataset.dragDirection === 'horizontal') {
      // 在确认是水平拖拽后再阻止默认（保留竖直滚动）
      e.preventDefault();
      offsetX = deltaX;
      // 用 rAF 批量写 transform，避免同步布局
      scheduleTransformWrite();
    }
    // vertical 不阻止 → 页面滚动
  }

  function finishSlideAnimation(direction) {
    if (!activeEl) return;
    isAnimating = true;

    const onEnd = (ev) => {
      if (ev.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
      activeEl.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);

      // 1️⃣ 立刻关掉过渡
      activeEl.classList.add('no-transition');

      // 2️⃣ 彻底清理 transform / opacity / scale
      activeEl.style.transform = '';
      activeEl.style.opacity = '';
      
      // ⚡ 强制浏览器应用（reflow）
      activeEl.offsetHeight;

      // 3️⃣ 重排数据结构
      if (direction < 0) order.push(order.shift());
      else order.unshift(order.pop());

      // 4️⃣ 应用 stack class（hide 会被安排好，但不会触发过渡）
      applyStackClasses(order);

      // 5️⃣ 下一帧移除 no-transition，为下一轮动画准备
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        activeEl && activeEl.classList.remove('no-transition');
      });

      isAnimating = false;
      activeEl = null;
      offsetX = 0;
    };

    activeEl.addEventListener('transitionend', onEnd);
  }

  function onPointerUp(e){
    if (!isPointerDown || !activeEl) return;
    isPointerDown = false;
    activeEl.classList.remove('no-transition');

    if (activeEl.dataset.dragDirection === 'horizontal') {
      const pass = Math.abs(offsetX) >= THRESHOLD;
      if (pass) {
        // 离场平移（使用 transitionend 监听）
        const dir = offsetX < 0 ? -1 : 1;
        // 设置过渡（只设置 transform，避免影响 left）
        activeEl.style.transition = `transform ${FLY_DURATION}ms ease`;
        // 触发平移到屏幕外
        activeEl.style.transform = `translate3d(${dir * FLY_DISTANCE}px,0,0)`;

        // 使用 transitionend 来完成 reorder（防抖更稳）
        // finishSlideAnimation 会在 transitionend 回调里 reorder
        finishSlideAnimation(dir);

      } else {
        // 回弹：平滑回到原位置
        activeEl.style.transition = `transform ${FLY_DURATION}ms ease`;
        activeEl.style.transform = '';
        // 在回弹结束后清理 transition（用 transitionend）
        const clean = (ev) => {
          if (ev.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
          activeEl.removeEventListener('transitionend', clean);
          activeEl.style.transition = '';
          activeEl = null;
          offsetX = 0;
        };
        activeEl.addEventListener('transitionend', clean);
      }
    }

    // 恢复 dragDirection 字段（安全）
    if (activeEl) activeEl.dataset.dragDirection = '';
    try { activeEl && activeEl.releasePointerCapture && activeEl.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(err){}
    // 如果 raf 未执行完，取消
    if (rafId) { cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); rafId = null; }
  }

  // 绑定事件（pointer API）
  order.forEach(s => {
    s.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: false });
    s.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
    s.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
    s.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);
    s.addEventListener('dragstart', ev => ev.preventDefault());
  });

  // 宽高变更时更新阈值和飞出距离（可选）
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    // 这里仅示意：如果你想同步动态阈值，放在外面重新计算常量
  });

})();

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

  function initSwiper() {
    var swiper = new Swiper(".mySwiper-template--18470869041330__vertical_screen_Nt67JK", {

        290: { slidesPerView: 1, spaceBetween: 6 },

      }
    });
  }

  initSwiper();

  // 遍历视频卡
  document.querySelectorAll('.video-card').forEach(function(card) {
    var video = card.querySelector('video');
    if (!video) return;

    // 播放按钮
    var control = document.createElement('div');
    control.className = 'video-control';
    control.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"></path></svg>';
    card.appendChild(control);

    // 进度条
    var progress = document.createElement('div');
    progress.className = 'video-progress';
    progress.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 50 50"><circle cx="25" cy="25" r="25"></circle></svg>';
    card.appendChild(progress);

    var circle = progress.querySelector('circle');
    var radius = 25;
    var circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
    circle.style.strokeDasharray = circumference;
    circle.style.strokeDashoffset = circumference;

    // 点击播放按钮
    control.addEventListener('click', function() {
      video.play();
      control.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 视频进度
    video.addEventListener('timeupdate', function() {
      var percent = video.currentTime / video.duration;
      circle.style.strokeDashoffset = circumference * (1 - percent);
    });

    // 播放结束显示按钮
    video.addEventListener('ended', function() {
      control.style.display = 'flex';
    });
  });
});
